speaker: Doctor
text:
I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your symptoms in detail, specifically regarding the fatigue, itching, and any other physical complaints you have experienced.

To better understand your condition, could you also tell me how long you have been feeling this way and if you have noticed any changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatitis B infection with secondary cholestasis. The combination of severe pruritus, fatigue, and known risk factors (sexual activity with multiple partners) strongly suggests viral hepatitis, likely Hepatitis B given the demographic and risk profile. I will order liver function tests and viral serology to confirm this diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel (ALT, AST, Alk Phos, Bilirubin), Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg), Hepatitis C Antibody, and HIV Antibody.
